messages:
sara: Quick sweep — we need to lock down owners + dates for INC-502 RCA. Target: close RCA by EOD Friday. Who's still on for their items?

matt: I'll take the DB migration cleanup (schema pruning + backfill). Plan: finish dev + tests by Wed, staging run Thu, production Thu COB.

olivia: infra change landed but I'm blocked on a /vpc ACL review from eng-infra. I pinged @kai-infra earlier; without that guard I can't do the rollback automation. ETA depends on their review. :thinking_face:

kai: saw your ping @olivia — I can do the ACL review today. If no surprises, expect green by 4pm PST. Will post PR link here. :thumbsup:

aj: I'll own the RCA writeup and timeline summary. Can draft the narrative Thursday morning and iterate. If folks drop fixes in, ping me with diff links so I can update the impact section.

matt: note — DB migration script includes `--dry-run` and a small data-check query. Putting it in the RCA doc under actions: https://redwood.inc/INC-502/rca (please add review comments)

olivia: acked — thanks @kai. If ACL is green by 4pm I can complete the rollback automation by 6pm and run a canary overnight.

incident-bot: [automation] canary pipeline triggered for INC-502 at 2071240200 — status: queued

kai: PR: https://git.redwood/repo/infra/pulls/482 — reviewers: @olivia @matt. Added notes about the ACL exception window.

matt: if we want to be safe, schedule a short post-deploy verification run Fri AM that validates the token latencies and error rate floor. I'll add a simple smoke script and share results in #eng-sre.

aj: sounds good. My plan: draft writeup Thu morning, review with sara Thu afternoon, finalize Fri EOD once fixes are confirmed. If anything slips, we extend closure target by 24h but call it out in RCA.

sara: sweet — summary action list from this thread (please react with :white_check_mark: when confirmed):
```
- matt: DB migration + smoke script — due Thu COB
- kai: ACL review PR — due today 4pm PST
- olivia: rollback automation & canary — due Thu 6pm (depends on ACL)
- aj: RCA draft + finalization — draft Thu AM, finalize Fri EOD
```

sara: Please drop any blockers here or DM if you need help coordinating with other teams. I'll do a quick follow-up at 4:15pm after kai's PR lands. :eyes:
